historical_references.reference: Santoshna was a renowned scholar and poetess in the 12th century during the Chalukyan Dynasty of Karnataka, India. She is known for her contributions to Sanskrit literature, particularly in the fields of poetry and philosophy.

Santoshna is also recognized as a devotional poetess in the Vaishnavite tradition, with her works primarily focusing on the worship of Lord Vishnu. Her poems often expressed deep devotion and longing for the divine, reflecting the spiritual climate of medieval India.
